sections.Purpose:
* **Letting anyone find a title.** The public site and [svc-search](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/search.md) read these rows, and no sign-in is needed.
* **Telling staff where a copy is.** A barcode, an owning branch and a shelf location are how an item is found or
  traced.
* **Recording what the consortium once held.** A withdrawn work stays in the catalogue, so a borrower learns the
  answer rather than nothing.

No lawful basis is recorded, and `data-subjects` is left out, because `personal-data` is `none`.
sections.Entities:
* **Work**: a title, independent of edition. Author, subject headings and a short description.
* **Edition**: one published form of a work. ISBN, publisher, year, format and language.
* **Item**: one physical copy on one shelf. Barcode, owning branch, shelf location and condition.
* **Branch**: a library building. Name, address, opening hours and the collections it keeps.
sections.Where it lives:
|                    |                                             |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| **Owning service** | [svc-catalogue-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/catalogue-api.md)                         |
| **Store**          | Azure SQL, database `sqldb-catalogue-<env>` |

This is the one domain in the estate that [svc-lending](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/lending.md) does not map. [svc-catalogue-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/catalogue-api.md) designed the schema and owns it outright.

Cover images sit apart from the rows that describe them, in the blob storage [svc-covers-cdn](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/covers-cdn.md) serves.
sections.Classification:
`public`. The consortium publishes the catalogue and wants it read. Anyone can browse it without signing in, and the same rows answer the public site and the staff tools. `personal-data` is `none`: an author's name describes a work and names no living person the consortium processes data about.

An item's condition note is the one field staff would rather not publish, and [svc-catalogue-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/catalogue-api.md) returns it to signed-in staff only. That is a presentation rule and not a classification: the row itself is public.
sections.Retention:
Kept indefinitely. A work stays in the catalogue after the last copy is withdrawn, because a borrower searching for it should learn that the consortium once held it.

A withdrawn item keeps its barcode. Barcodes are never reused, so an old loan still resolves to the item it named.
sections.Flows:
| Goes to          | Why                                   | What is shared                      | Where they process it |
|------------------|---------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|-----------------------|
| [svc-search](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/search.md)     | Building the search index             | Work, edition and item, in full     | UK South              |
| [svc-covers-cdn](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/services/covers-cdn.md) | Serving a cover image beside a result | ISBN and the cover image it selects | UK South              |

Most of this domain arrives rather than leaves. [itg-bibliographic-data](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c32ef7e752de946ec0ebf6d1dadc53305cf06df5/examples/library/integrations/bibliographic-data.md) supplies the work and edition records, and the consortium adds the item and branch records to them. That direction is not recorded in `flows-to`, which lists recipients only.
